claims.claim_text: Architected a governed, policy-gated agent execution surface for enterprise AI workflows, combining L0 route-policy dispatch, multi-agent orchestration contracts, and human override escalation paths to keep agentic delivery auditable.
Built CFO-aligned enterprise adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization, pairing usage-based forecasting with partner deal support to sustain recurring revenue growth.
Delivered audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows by instituting evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls across production agent execution.
Standardized the AI systems lifecycle from intake through production monitoring, compressing lab-to-production cycle time from six months to three weeks through managed workflow orchestration.

Engineered high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms, integrating Databricks Lakehouse pipelines and dense-sparse retrieval design into resilient runtime infrastructure.
Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while converting bespoke delivery into a commercialized, reusable agentic platform operating model spanning enterprise lines of business.
